name.value: Eileen Dailly Leisure Pool & Fitness Centre

description.value: Eileen Dailly Leisure Pool & Fitness Centre is a City of Burnaby public recreation facility in the Burnaby Heights neighbourhood, offering a beach-entry leisure pool, a deep tank main pool, and a well-equipped weight and cardio room. It sits directly adjacent to Confederation Park, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists exploring the area. The centre is operated by the City of Burnaby and offers both drop-in and registered aquatic and fitness programming for the community.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active City of Burnaby public leisure pool and fitness centre in the Burnaby Heights neighbourhood, with aquatic pools and a cardio/weight room. The phone number (604-298-7946) matches the OSM tag. The website explicitly mentions lockers for item storage (transitioning from coin-operated to personal-padlock after July 6), but does not explicitly mention bike parking, washrooms, or water refill stations, so those required criteria remain null per evidence rules.
concerns: Website notes an annual maintenance closure from June 1–July 5 (full closure) and a waterslide closure until further notice — these are temporary but may affect visitor experience.
Locker system changing July 6 from coin-operated to personal-padlock; cyclists should be aware they need to bring or purchase a padlock.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a well-established, actively operated public recreation centre that would likely serve touring cyclists (lockers confirmed, pool and fitness access), but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be explicitly confirmed from website content and should be verified on-site or by phone.
